company.statement: SuperMega connects shop work, plant work, websites, ecommerce ordering, evidence, and owner decisions in one accountable system.
company.headline: One operating layer behind the work your company already does.
company.supporting: Run Shop and Plant, build Website and Ecommerce experiences, and add bounded AI assistance without forcing people through disconnected tools.

customerProducts.name: Shop
customerProducts.headline: Keep every order and stock movement accountable.
customerProducts.description: Run browser-local orders, stock, fulfilment, payment status, exceptions, and daily close across common channels. No live channel, checkout, payment, delivery, customer send, or external write is connected.
modules: Orders: intake, fulfilment, payments, follow-up and close
Stock: catalogue, balances, receipts and reorder exceptions
Accountability: evidence, owner review and recovery

templates.name: Social commerce
templates.outcome: Convert trusted chat channels into structured orders, stock movement, fulfilment, and follow-up.
templates.metric: Order handling time and completion rate

templates.name: Retail and wholesale
templates.outcome: Control customer orders, stock, payment, delivery, and daily reconciliation.

templates.name: Restaurant ordering
templates.outcome: Coordinate channel orders, preparation, handoff, delivery, payment, and close.

customerProducts.name: Plant
customerProducts.headline: Give the plant floor one operational memory.
customerProducts.description: Run recurring jobs, output, machine state, quality, maintenance, exceptions, and shift handoffs in a clearly labelled local demo. Authenticated tenant writes stay locked until managed activation gates pass. No machine telemetry, machine control, access change, or external write is connected.
modules: Jobs: recurring plans, targets and confirmed output
Problems: quality, materials, equipment and maintenance
Accountability: shift evidence, owner review and recovery

templates.name: Production control
templates.outcome: Plan, run, confirm, and review output by line, shift, and product.
templates.metric: Plan attainment and confirmed good output

templates.name: Maintenance and downtime
templates.outcome: Record machine state, stoppages, ownership, repair, and return to service.
templates.metric: Downtime and mean time to restore

templates.name: Quality and traceability
templates.outcome: Capture checks, exceptions, evidence, approval, and lot history.
templates.metric: Exception closure time and trace completeness

customerProducts.name: Website
customerProducts.headline: Turn an approved brief into a reviewable website.

templates.name: Business presence
templates.outcome: Create a clear mobile-first company website with services, proof, and one contact path.
templates.metric: Qualified contact starts and content approval time

templates.name: Lead generation
templates.outcome: Turn one offer into a focused landing experience with attributable proof and enquiry intent.
templates.metric: Qualified enquiry rate and response readiness

templates.name: Catalog showcase
templates.outcome: Present a finite product or service collection and route approved interest into accountable follow-up.
templates.metric: Catalog completion and enquiry handoff accuracy

customerProducts.name: Ecommerce
customerProducts.headline: Create a Shop-backed storefront and hand customer intent to human review.
workflow: Optionally retain exact receipt in authenticated Shop inbox

templates.name: Social storefront
templates.outcome: Give chat-first sellers a focused Shop-backed catalog and a reviewable order-request handoff.
templates.metric: Request completion and Shop confirmation time

templates.name: Pickup and preorder
templates.outcome: Collect product intent for pickup or preorder without creating payment or stock side effects.
templates.metric: Confirmed request rate and promise accuracy

templates.name: Wholesale request
templates.outcome: Present a controlled wholesale assortment and hand quantity requests to a named Shop reviewer.
templates.metric: Qualified wholesale requests and review cycle time

proof: Idempotent receipt and exact managed replay
Revision, action-identity, and cross-tenant conflict rejection
Unchanged Shop orders and stock movements
Stale, duplicate, unknown, sold-out, repriced, insufficient-stock, oversized-inbox, and tampered request rejection
boundaries: Managed inbox uses a 100-entry revisioned Shop workspace pilot envelope; a normalized indexed queue is gated on measured scale
No Shop order or stock reservation before separate accountable confirmation

sharedCapabilities.name: AI assistance
sharedCapabilities.headline: Prepare bounded work, then let the responsible person decide.
